BiblicalUsage: The lance is the weapon of the giant's son: Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the single lance as the last threat of the giants, and David's deliverance as the end of it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
